title: Free Recall of Word Lists with Repeated Items
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial electrophysiological (iEEG) recordings from a repeated-item free recall task. Participants studied visually presented word lists, each containing 27 encoding events drawn from 12 unique words repeated one, two, or three times. After a 7-second delay they freely recalled the words in any order. Data were collected at clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania.
methods_description: Participants viewed word lists one word at a time, followed by a 7-second delay and a free recall phase. Word presentation duration varied across sessions (750 ms to 1600 ms). iEEG was recorded with Blackrock and Medtronic systems and provided in both monopolar and bipolar referencing, with per-subject electrode montages and MNI/Talairach coordinates when available.
